title: Moving loose impediments
question: You find some leaves and twigs touching your ball on the fairway. What can you do according to the rules?

choices.text: You can remove them but will get a penalty
Only remove them after asking your marker

explanation: Loose impediments like leaves and twigs may be removed anywhere on the course, including the fairway, without penalty.
imagePrompt: A teen girl golfer on the fairway carefully picks up a twig and some leaves from next to her ball before taking her shot.
imageAlt: Teen girl golfer removing a twig and leaves from beside her golf ball on short grass.

imageVerification.repairPrompt: No significant repairs needed. Maintain current high accuracy in club details, posture, ball size, outfit colours, and skin tone.
